tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and data pipeline optimization. I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into scalable SAP Commerce solutions. Experienced in agile delivery, production troubleshooting, and AI-assisted development to drive high-performance e-commerce outcomes.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Consultant/Architect role at Jobster. With over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise-grade e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my technical expertise and techno-functional approach to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive experience designing and implementing backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, ensuring platform best practices for complex B2B/B2C environments.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: I specialize in building robust data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, including Profisee and SAP ERP, to ensure seamless synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: My work involves bridging the gap between business and technical teams by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and user stories.

bullets.label: API & Headless Development
bullets.text: I have successfully developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, enabling high-performance storefronts and PWA integrations.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with Jobster's goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich auf die Position als Senior Consultant/Architect bei Jobster. Durch meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung komplexer SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte technische Expertise und eine ausgeprägte techno-funktionale Arbeitsweise mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung in der Implementierung von SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 und der Anwendung von Best Practices in anspruchsvollen E-Commerce-Umgebungen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenflüsse
bullets.text: Ich bin spezialisiert auf die Konzeption und Optimierung von Datenpipelines zwischen PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen, um eine konsistente Datenhaltung sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: In meiner Rolle fungiere ich als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT, indem ich Geschäftsanforderungen analysiere und in präzise funktionale Spezifikationen übersetze.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von OCC REST Web Services und Headless-APIs zur Anbindung moderner Storefronts und PWA-Lösungen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland. Mein Arbeitsverhältnis endet am 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für neue Herausforderungen zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: Jobster's reputation for delivering high-impact e-commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my background in complex SAP Commerce integrations. I am drawn to your focus on architectural excellence and your commitment to driving digital transformation for enterprise clients. I am eager to contribute my expertise in Java, Spring, and techno-functional analysis to help Jobster continue delivering scalable, high-performance commerce platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by solving complex integration challenges and delivering scalable e-commerce solutions. My goal is to leverage my SAP Commerce expertise to drive value for Jobster's clients through technical precision and effective business-IT alignment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I'm a Senior SAP Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell & Shell. I'm currently looking for new challenges in Germany and would love to discuss how my background in SAP CX integrations could support the Jobster team. Best, Kranti Chavan.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Consultant/Architect | SAP CX - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant/Architect position at Jobster. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud development and techno-functional consulting, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am currently serving my notice period and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing my application with you.

Best regards,

Kranti Chavan
